name: MPI Master Node Parallel Rendering Workflow
definition: Coordinates parallel volume rendering by spawning slave processes via MPI, distributing transfer function and rendering parameters, receiving per-slice image data, assembling the full image, encoding to JPEG, and transmitting over TCP.
summary: The MPI Master Node Parallel Rendering Workflow is a master-slave architecture that coordinates slave processes to render volume slices and assembles the final image from per-slice fragments, distinguished by handling domain decomposition and concatenation within a pre-defined workflow rather than the rendering loop.
